8. Publish and submit
Report service
Stores the report in S3 with a hash, publishes it in OSCAL formats, and submits it to regulatory authorities where supported.

7. Approve the report
Authorized approver in the Admin console
An authorized person reviews the draft and approves it. Approved reports cannot be edited; changes create a new version.

span.p:
6. Generate a report
Report service
Builds a report at any time from the latest COMPLETE score and current remediation status, showing PENDING items as such. AI drafts a summary.

span.p:
5. Verify the fix with Project 2
Remediation service
For each RESOLVED remediation, asks Project 2 to re-assess the control. A passing result marks it VERIFIED; a failing result reopens it.

4. Act on remediations
Compliance reviewers in the Admin console
Reviewers assign and update remediations, then mark each as RESOLVED or RISK_ACCEPTED, with a justification on record.

3. Create remediations
Remediation service
Consumes ScoreCompleted and opens a remediation for each non-compliant finding, prioritized by score. AI suggests actions.

2. Calculate risk and compliance scores
Score engine
Runs on AssessmentReceived, on a schedule, or on request. Scores findings by likelihood, impact, severity, and control effectiveness.
